title: Reference Prompt Sentinel for Quantization QC
creator: Ava Morgan
description: Build an automated accuracy validation harness that uses a compact set of reference prompts (a 'sentinel' set) plus synthetic perturbations to gate FP8/INT8 quantization profiles. The harness will run as part of PR CI and nightly regression jobs, compute statistically robust metrics, and produce pass/fail decisions and a human-readable report for ML engineers and release owners.
acceptance_criteria: A curated sentinel prompt set (≈250 prompts) covering short-form Q&A, code, reasoning, and multi-turn context must be available in the canonical dataset store with provenance and labels.
The CI job runs quantization calibration -> run-harness -> report pipeline and completes within 90 minutes for a single model profile on our standard test infra.

Metrics computed: token-level perplexity delta, KL divergence on next-token distributions, top-k response overlap, and prompt-level EM/ROUGE delta. Each metric must include 95% bootstrap confidence intervals.
Pass/fail gating logic implemented: two-tier gate (automated synthetic gate + human review gate) with configurable thresholds per-model family.
Harness outputs a JSON report (flat schema) and an HTML summary uploaded to the evaluation dashboard; failing runs create a GitHub PR comment and Slack alert to #quant-ops.
Integration tests that simulate calibration perturbations (scale shifts, histogram clipping, per-layer bias) and show expected gate failures for at least three injected fault modes.
Documentation for operators (how to add prompts, adjust thresholds, and interpret CI signals) published in Confluence link in 'links'.
implementation_notes: Sentinel set construction: start from existing golden prompts, add stratified sampling across token length, domain, and coercion difficulty. Include adversarial variants (paraphrases, stopword noise, temperature-sampled decoys).
Calibration workflow: run existing calibration job to produce quant scales, then apply INT8/FP8 profile to inference runtime; capture raw logits for downstream metrics calculation.
Metric computation: use bootstrap (n=1000) for CI, compute delta against float32 baseline. Mark significant regressions where lower bound of CI exceeds configured threshold.
Gating: automated gate checks for statistical regressions and a secondary human-review flag if regression is close to threshold or heterogeneous across cohorts.
Cohort segmentation: enable per-cohort metrics (short vs long prompts, code vs natural language, multi-turn). Gate fails if any high-priority cohort shows high regression.
CI integration: GitHub Actions workflow template under .github/workflows/quant-qc.yaml that spins a reproducible Docker job on dedicated GPU runners; artifacts archived to S3.

Reporting: create condensed JSON with top-k example failures (input, float output summary, quant output summary, metric deltas) to aid debugging. HTML report uses highlight diffs and token-level heatmaps.
Rollout workflow: tie into console canary rollout; failing gate should block profile promotion; successful runs tag profile with 'qc-passed' and timestamp.
Telemetry: emit structured events for each run (duration, sample size, metric values) to the monitoring pipeline for trend detection and alerting.
progress_updates: 2025-02-10 - Ticket created after spike with ML Infra. Identified need for compact sentinel set to speed CI while preserving representativeness.

2025-02-12 - Prototype harness implemented for one fp8 profile; initial runs show tight correlation between KL and qualitative regressions on code prompts. PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/runtimes/pull/812
2025-02-14 - Design review with PM and Design to finalize HTML summary layout and failure example format. Decided to highlight cohort-level deltas and attach minimal token diffs.

2025-02-17 - Implemented bootstrap CI calculation and integrated with existing calibration job. Discovered flaky behavior when sample size < 200 prompts; added minimum-sample check and synthetic augmentation.

2025-02-21 - End-to-end run in nightly job completed for 'llm-small' INT8 profile; one cohort (multi-turn reasoning) failed automated gate. Created follow-up bug ENG-24835 for per-layer scale mismatch investigation.
Blockers: need approval for additional GPU CI capacity from infra; awaiting quota increase request.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Sentinel set may not cover rare but customer-visible failure modes. Mitigation: provide easy process for PMs and SEs to submit new prompts and tag with customer examples; maintain a 'critical' subset that triggers human review.

Risk: Flaky CI due to non-deterministic sampling or low sample sizes. Mitigation: enforce deterministic seeds, use stratified sampling, and require min sample count; fallback to nightly larger runs for statistical power.
Risk: Overly strict thresholds block valid profile improvements. Mitigation: two-tier gate and configurable tolerances per model-family; human-in-the-loop for edge cases.
Risk: High compute cost for frequent runs. Mitigation: compact sentinel set for PRs, full regression nightly, and opportunistic sampling for low-traffic models.

Risk: Alerts fatigue from small, non-actionable regressions. Mitigation: require both statistical significance and cohort-level effect size before auto-failing; otherwise surface as degraded with priority
